The local reveal consumer uses a strict planar distance-under-40 condition. Ground lookup and transformation were independently inspected; the transform can set up a joint matrix, so a blanket no-mutation contract is inappropriate. Accepted nine-route identity, audio and layout deferrals while retaining scheduling and lifetime mechanics. Zero-spread branches avoid HSD_Randi. A negative saved timer triggers creation and disarms even on failure; only success records the parent backlink. Later termination rearms the parent and releases resources. Initialization, selection, transform and process use different union views, so source-level operations do not prove a unified compiled payload. The child-creation test precedes and is independent of the phase branch.

Accepted remaining no-op damage-notification and transient-effect identity deferrals. Foreign reads establish grMaterial forwarding and Yaku damage-dealt dispatch, so those mechanics are supported rather than inferred from rendered names. Nevertheless, empty callbacks do not identify Banzai Bill or its explosion, prove all consequences of contact damage, or establish sound identity. The animation/camera/material lifecycle is retained without those extensions.

Accepted the three-retained-actor identity contradictions and corresponding link deferrals. These objects initialize linked geometry, blink, install interaction callbacks, activate that geometry and follow an assigned joint. They must not be identified with the distinct nine-route family through mutually reinforcing rendered BanzaiBill names. Both fallthroughs and the final transform update, including a reset tick, remain significant. Position comes from a transform helper, not a direct translation-field copy; the quake is symbolically QuakeKind_Small.

Accepted scheduler-state and weighting deferrals. Eligibility permits the -1 sentinel or a non-null previously selected object with non-null payload and zero tested state; it does not permit a null selected object. Weighted selection does not filter newly chosen null entries or test the new actor's idle state. State 1 is assigned only after a target entity is found. Previous-slot division is parameter-dependent, not guaranteed weight reduction.

Accepted the remaining interaction identity, hitlag and duration deferrals. Both callbacks request state 4 before the fighter test; Yaku supplies the retained Ground owner and relevant interacting object. The classifier is null-safe and the setter writes Fighter.dmg.x1958. These reads do not establish the field's complete downstream hitlag semantics, an approximately one-second duration, same-color association or a projectile impact/explosion identity.

Accepted temporary-geometry identity and exact-state-summary deferrals. Three configurations populate different subsets of five storage slots, including entries without paired effects. State 1 resamples duration until reveal completes. State 3 continues bounce updates but does not toggle rendering on its transition-to-4 tick. These mechanics support the structural summaries without proving exact colors or five item-bearing objects per instance.

Accepted indexed interaction, reachability and layout deferrals. Proxy registration requires a non-null visible effect_a; reviewed configurations do not supply it for slots 2–4. The wrappers' indices and immediate x134/x10C mutations are supported, but compiled equivalence to castle10 state, globally numbered colored blocks, recursion-prevention intent and immediate-retrigger guarantees are not established. Foreign reads verify the shared owner-dispatch and removal mechanics, not the complete composite gameplay claims.

Accepted bounce/item-response deferrals and their factual qualifications. The table contains five applied offsets, 4, 6, 7, 6, 4, followed by a -1 restoration sentinel. The external action occurs at zero-based index 3, not the middle displacement, and requires eligible controller state plus effect_a. The Y velocity is configured, not proven positive. Exact random-item semantics, item-enabled conditions and visible block identities remain deferred.

Accepted rendering-boundary deferrals. The local callback forwards ordinary drawing and conditionally submits populated dynamics entries with boundary 999. The foreign renderer uses pass 2 for alpha 254, width 12, half RGB below the boundary and full RGB at or above it. Without asset chain lengths, every vertex being dimmed is not established. Matrix updates during drawing are not simulation advancement.

Accepted plane, particle and geometric-predicate deferrals. The code establishes strict scaled-plane comparisons, conditional output and a crossing-triggered scaled generator, not independently water or splash presentation. The geometric predicate rejects one region before accessing the joint; its transform helper may update matrix state, contradicting an unconditional read-only/no-input-mutation contract.
